category_title: Children from lower socioeconomic backgrounds experiencing daily stressors and ruminative thoughts
minimal_context: The student is preparing to take the SIGMAS and MICRAS standardized tests in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright, it is time to prepare for the SIGMAS and MICRAS standardized tests. Please clear your desks.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't really stay on top of everything. It's having too much on my mind.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just do your best to get ready for the exam.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I have a headache before we even start and I feel horrible.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to begin the test now. Please look at the first page.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't, there's stuff in my stomach, and I feel kind of nervous, it's like, kind of tickling me in the stomach, and you're thinking you're going to do fine, but then you're still stressed.
